sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: In Yoga, what is the term used for the practice of controlled and synchronized breathing?
options: A) Asana
B) Pranayama
C) Mudra
D) Dhyana

questions.question_text: In the game of Kho-Kho, how do players in the defending team primarily try to avoid getting tagged by the chaser?
options: A) By running outside the field boundaries
B) By dodging and running in zig-zag patterns
C) By sitting down on the ground
D) By throwing a ball at the chaser
questions.answer: B) By dodging and running in zig-zag patterns

questions.question_text: Which Yoga posture is known as the 'Cobra Pose' and helps in strengthening the spine and expanding the chest?
options: A) Bhujangasana
B) Tadasana
C) Shavasana
D) Padmasana

questions.question_text: In the traditional game of Kabaddi, what is a 'chain tackle'?
options: A) Hitting the raider with a heavy ball
B) Defenders holding hands to encircle and trap the raider
C) Running entirely alone to catch the raider
D) Stepping out of bounds intentionally
questions.answer: B) Defenders holding hands to encircle and trap the raider

questions.question_text: Why is focusing your eyes on a single stationary point important during balancing poses like Vrikshasana (Tree Pose)?
options: A) It improves your eyesight for reading
B) It helps maintain physical stability and mental concentration
C) It prevents you from feeling thirsty
D) It prevents neck and shoulder pain
questions.answer: B) It helps maintain physical stability and mental concentration

questions.question_text: What is the primary physical requirement for the chaser in the traditional game of Langdi?
options: A) Swimming fast across the field
B) Hopping continuously on one leg
C) Jumping over high hurdles
D) Throwing a heavy stone
questions.answer: B) Hopping continuously on one leg

questions.question_text: What is the main physical benefit of practicing Vajrasana (Diamond Pose) immediately after eating a meal?
options: A) It builds strong arm and shoulder muscles
B) It prepares the body for rapid running
C) It aids in digestion and strengthens the lower back
D) It improves throwing and catching skills
questions.answer: C) It aids in digestion and strengthens the lower back

questions.question_text: In traditional games like Seven Stones (Pitthu/Lagori), what is the main objective of the attacking team after the stones are scattered?
options: A) To run away and hide from the defenders
B) To stack the stones back together without getting hit by the ball
C) To catch the defending team members
D) To kick the stones out of the playing field
questions.answer: B) To stack the stones back together without getting hit by the ball

questions.question_text: Which posture is typically performed at the very end of a Yoga session for deep physical and mental relaxation?
options: A) Surya Namaskar
B) Shavasana (Corpse Pose)
C) Vrikshasana
D) Trikonasana

questions.question_text: How does actively participating in community sports positively affect a student's mental health?
options: A) It causes extreme anger and sadness
B) It reduces stress and promotes a sense of teamwork and belonging
C) It makes the person very tired and weak mentally
D) It severely decreases their academic focus
questions.answer: B) It reduces stress and promotes a sense of teamwork and belonging

questions.question_text: Explain the importance of synchronizing your breath with your body movements during Yoga practice. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Synchronizing breath with movement helps deliver more oxygen to the muscles. It calms the nervous system, deepens physical stretches, and significantly improves overall focus and stamina.

questions.question_text: State the primary strategy used by the defending team in Kho-Kho to waste the chaser's time. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Defenders use agile footwork to run in tight circles around the central poles or abruptly change directions, forcing the chaser to constantly pass the 'Kho'.

questions.question_text: Describe the correct sitting posture for practicing Pranayama to ensure maximum lung expansion. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Sit cross-legged with your spine perfectly straight, shoulders relaxed, and chest gently lifted. Keep your hands resting softly on your knees with your head aligned upward.

questions.question_text: Why is team communication crucial during a fast-paced game of Seven Stones (Lagori)? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Team communication alerts players about where the ball is located, helping them coordinate safely to rebuild the stone stack while avoiding being tagged by opponents.

questions.question_text: How does regular practice of Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutation) benefit a student's daily life? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: It acts as a full-body workout that improves flexibility, builds muscular strength, and enhances blood circulation, keeping the student highly energetic and focused throughout the day.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are guiding a beginner into the Padmasana (Lotus Pose). Describe the steps and the feeling of inner calmness it brings. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Sit on the floor, gently place your right foot on your left thigh, and your left foot on your right thigh. Keep your back completely straight. Close your eyes and breathe deeply. You will feel a profound sense of inner peace and deep mental stability.

questions.question_text: Imagine playing Kabaddi. Describe the physical actions and breathing control required when you enter the opponent's half as a raider. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: As a raider, take a deep breath before crossing the midline. Continuously chant "Kabaddi" while exhaling. Stay low, move with quick, agile steps to dodge defenders, and use fast lunges to tag an opponent before quickly retreating to your side.

questions.question_text: Explain how practicing balancing postures in Yoga Sadhana, along with deep breathing, helps improve a student's concentration and emotional stability in school. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Balancing postures require intense physical focus, training the brain to ignore distractions and stay present. Deep, synchronized breathing lowers the heart rate and reduces anxiety. Together, these practices build strong mental endurance and emotional control, helping students stay remarkably calm during exams and focus much better during challenging classes.

questions.question_text: Describe how playing traditional community games like Kho-Kho develops both physical agility and strong social bonds among neighborhood children. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Traditional games require explosive sprinting, sudden dodging, and quick reflexes, which drastically improve physical agility and cardiovascular stamina. Simultaneously, these cooperative team-based games teach children how to strategize together, communicate effectively under pressure, resolve minor conflicts, and celebrate shared victories, thereby building deep mutual trust and lasting neighborhood friendships.
